entities.summary: Ivo Klec is a Slovak former tennis player. He played mainly on the ATP Challenger Tour. On the ITF Futures circuit, he has claimed 29 titles, 14 singles and 15 doubles. In addition, he has also won two ATP Challenger doubles titles.
